instruments.notes: Hedges approximately 10 percent of 1998 crude production; WTI-based average floor and ceiling. Volume not stated.
instruments.evidence_quote:
The Partnership has entered into collar agreements to hedge
approximately 10 percent of its 1998 crude production at an average floor price
of $19.87 WTI per barrel and an average ceiling price of $21.15 WTI per barrel.

instruments.notes: Approximately 25 percent of estimated 1998 gas production; Henry Hub-based average floor and ceiling. Volume not stated.
instruments.evidence_quote:
Approximately 25 percent of its estimated 1998 gas production is under hedging
agreements using collars at an average floor price of $2.21 HH per mmbtu and an
average ceiling price of $2.42 HH per mmbtu.

instruments.notes: Note 2 (financial instruments) description at Dec 31, 1997: crude oil contracts hedging about 9 percent of estimated 1998 production at an average price; instrument type not stated and may overlap with the collars described in MD&A. Aggregate fair value of derivative assets approx $5 million (not split by instrument).
instruments.evidence_quote:
At December 31, 1997, the Partnership was a party to crude oil contracts to
hedge about 9 percent of its estimated 1998 crude oil production at an average
price of $20.17 per barrel.

instruments.notes: Note 2 description at Dec 31, 1997: approximately 20 percent of estimated 1998 natural gas production hedged; instrument type not stated and may overlap with the gas collars described in MD&A.
instruments.evidence_quote:
Approximately 20 percent of its estimated 1998
natural gas production was hedged at $2.19 per mmbtu.

instruments.notes: Prior-year position at Dec 31, 1996: contracts hedging about 20 percent of estimated 1997 crude oil production at $20.30 per barrel; instrument type not stated.
instruments.evidence_quote:
At December 31, 1996, the
Partnership was a party to crude oil and natural gas contracts to hedge about 20
percent of its estimated 1997 crude oil production at $20.30 per barrel and 31
percent of its estimated 1997 natural gas production at $2.24 per mmbtu.

instruments.notes: Prior-year position at Dec 31, 1996: contracts hedging 31 percent of estimated 1997 natural gas production at $2.24 per mmbtu; instrument type not stated.
instruments.evidence_quote:
At December 31, 1996, the
Partnership was a party to crude oil and natural gas contracts to hedge about 20
percent of its estimated 1997 crude oil production at $20.30 per barrel and 31

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Enters into commodity futures contracts/hedging arrangements with major financial institutions to manage crude oil and natural gas price risk and maintain specified margins; not for trading purposes.
